    Getting started

    Custom Toolbar registers its available modules after Unity imports the package. No component needs to be added to a scene.

    Configure scene folders

    1. Open Edit > Project Settings > NKStudio > Custom Toolbar.
    2. Expand Scene Search Folders.
    3. Add Assets or one or more folders under it, such as Assets/Scenes.

    The scene menu lists scenes found in those folders. Invalid folders, duplicate paths, and paths outside Assets are removed when the setting is saved.

    The first-scene button opens the first enabled scene in File > Build Profiles (called Build Settings in earlier Unity versions).

    Choose visible modules

    Use Visible Modules in the same settings page to show or hide each feature:

    • Enter Play Mode Options
    • Scene Switcher
    • Time Scale
    • Localization
    • FMOD Debug

    Localization and FMOD Debug also require their optional packages. Changing a visibility setting refreshes the toolbar.

    Configure time scale

    Set the minimum, maximum, and reset values under Time Scale. The reset value is kept within the configured minimum and maximum range.

    Use the toolbar slider to change Time.timeScale. Open its menu to restore the configured reset value.
